requirements.text: Preserve every byte and lifecycle state of the 2026-08-01 Refactor Acceptance plan and add only separately owned evidence.
Provide one repository-owned Skill-package validation and replay entrypoint for future terminal validators without a hard-coded user profile or absolute Codex Skill path.
Resolve the installed validator through a bounded capability contract and record resolved path, version, content identity, package identity and probe result in a non-authorizing receipt.
Fail closed when the validator capability is missing, substituted, drifted, incompatible, escaping its declared root or unable to distinguish detached valid and invalid fixtures.
Add a compatibility replay record for the historical machine-bound validation step without claiming the original command was portable or rerunning history as new authority.
Create an append-only evaluation-seed manifest for the three 2026-08-01 repair families with exact native evidence references and content hashes.
Classify every seed only as an anchor candidate, challenge candidate or explicitly non-baseline exploratory candidate; no seed may become an accepted quality baseline.
Define and execute a stable-versus-candidate replay matrix for affected Refactor Acceptance validation surfaces without claiming one plan or consumer proves universal quality.
Re-run the workflow-model-routing terminal consumer against the current repository as a higher-level compatibility replay.
Keep generated receipts, compatibility records, seeds, matrices and replay summaries non-authorizing and separate from VDD, implementation and Acceptance lifecycle owners.
Provide deterministic disable and rollback behavior that restores callers to their previous validator command without deleting failed or historical evidence.
Do not modify Phase service, hosted runtime, live workspaces, browser/API, account, project, sandbox or BMAD/GDS installed files.
Do not absorb TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 and do not introduce Experience Memory, Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, learned ranking or RL.

acceptance.assertion: The complete tracked byte manifest for the 2026-08-01 plan matches the frozen TC-D1 authority manifest before and after implementation.
No TC-D1 command writes into the historical 2026-08-01 directory.
A repository-relative entrypoint validates a detached Skill package on Windows without embedding a user-profile path.
The command registry and core Skill instructions route future package validation through the repository-owned entrypoint.
The capability descriptor admits only the declared Skill Creator root and relative validator entrypoint and rejects escape or substitution.
A successful receipt binds the validator path, version, SHA-256, target package manifest, probes, command identity and exit result and carries authorizes empty.
Detached tests prove missing, drifted, substituted, escaping and semantically incompatible capabilities fail closed before a success receipt.
The compatibility record binds the historical validator bytes and command evidence plus a current wrapper replay, labels the old step machine-bound, and carries authorizes empty.

The seed manifest names candidate-baseline-contamination, self-hosted-knowledge-read-set-collision and toolchain-policy-architecture-index-gap exactly once with native evidence path and hash bindings.
Missing or drifted native seed evidence fails validation and never becomes unknown success.
Every seed declares baseline_status non-authorizing and uses only an approved candidate class; no accepted baseline or quality label is emitted.
The stable-versus-candidate matrix covers positive, negative, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set and closed policy cases with explicit expected observations.
The current workflow-model-routing terminal validator passes and its receipt is recorded as one downstream compatibility observation only.
Every TC-D1 derived artifact carries authorizes empty and cannot publish plan-ready, implementation-complete, acceptance-passed, release or archive.
Disabling the new caller route restores the prior validator selection while preserving all new and historical receipts; failed candidates are not deleted.
Candidate and command manifests contain no Phase, runtime, hosted workspace, browser/API, account, sandbox or installed BMAD/GDS write path.
Plan validation rejects active TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 requirements, slices, baseline publication, Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification or RL behavior.
